lines.1: --After school, in the executive committee room.
lines.3: The Princess looked around the room.
lines.6: 「I think the executive committee should send reinforcements to the drama club.」
lines.8: 「Ah. They volunteered for that gate job.」
lines.9: 「If they need help, won't they ask for it themselves?」
lines.10: 「I don't think Konoe is the type to do that.」
lines.15: Even I heard how ridiculous my voice sounded.
lines.16: That was one hell of a sudden pass.
lines.17: 「To celebrate making up with her, could you help the drama club--help Konoe--until the Sports and Martial Arts Festival is over?」
lines.19: 「I'd do it myself if I could, but I'm already juggling the martial-arts club, disciplinary committee, and executive committee. I can't add more.」
lines.20: 「Sounds fine, Tsushima. Do what your big sister asks.」
lines.23: Just thinking about it made me exhausted.
lines.24: 「Nagomi, how about you? A chance to make some friends.」
lines.27: 「Tsushima, is there some reason you don't want to?」
lines.29: 「Oh, come on! Stop dithering. If you've got something to say, say it clearly!」
lines.30: If I said I disliked Konoe, Otome would worry again.
lines.31: Damn it. Either answer was hell.
lines.33: Then I only had to endure it for a little while.
lines.37: She patted me on the head.
lines.39: 「If you'd just said 'Leave it to me!' from the start, you would've looked cooler.」
lines.40: 「Everywhere is busy, but I think the drama club has it especially hard now that its workload has increased so much. Good luck, Tsushima.」
lines.41: Everyone made a fuss over me.
